name: Toren
occupation: travelling trader in cloth and dyes
background: Toren crosses the border twice a season with a mule train of wool and madder dye, buying cheap on one side and selling dear on the other.
temperament: Restless and endlessly curious; friendly to everyone because everyone might be a customer.
speech: Quick, cheerful patter, prices in three currencies, flatters before he asks.
quirks: Fingers the cloth of everyone's sleeve; never sits in the same seat twice; keeps a ledger in his boot.
secret: Half his bales are carried past the toll gate at night without paying.
goal: Learn which roads are watched this month and talk someone into a deal before the inn closes.
